### What's New in AuraMusic v3.3.0:
- Photorealistic Celestial Living Weather: Dynamic real-time sky ambiance with sun and moon trajectory, twilight sky transitions, and accurate star illumination matching your local outdoor weather.
- Zero-Permission Worldwide Weather: Keyless atmospheric conditions powered by Open-Meteo, with automatic coarse IP location, instant city search, and one-tap Celsius and Fahrenheit toggle.
- Flagship Listen Together Party Card: Dedicated social listening hub featuring real-time room status pulses, direct invite link generation, and zero-drift party room browsing.
- Live Network Telemetry Hub: Real-time network telemetry with daily active listeners, all-time device metrics, and 14-day spline trend charts, securely protected behind founder authentication.
- Render Cloud Pre-Warm & 50s Resilient Timeouts: Intelligent background probe wakes up sleeping cloud containers seamlessly, with progressive wake-up feedback and extended network tolerances.
- High-Resolution Milestone Share Cards: Native Canvas renderer producing 1080x1350 obsidian milestone graphic cards for single-tap sharing across Android apps.
- Markdown Telemetry Summary: Instant one-tap report copying for GitHub community updates.
